method.detrend: per-quarter median normalisation; 1.0 d time-windowed running median, two-pass (upward 3-MAD clip removed; >5-MAD dips excluded from trend estimate)
method.bls: astropy BoxLeastSquares, objective=likelihood, durations [0.03, 0.045, 0.06, 0.08, 0.11, 0.15, 0.2, 0.27] d, log-uniform frequency grid dlnf = 0.04 d / (2 * baseline), 1-50 d
method.sde: (max power - mean power) / std power over the 1-50 d grid
method.depth: median(out-of-box) - mean(in-box); error = std of the same statistic over random-phase boxes of the same width (empirical)
method.dataset_B: post-hoc: drop quarters whose median PSF-fit RED_CHI2 > 100000
